ancients.intro: Spreads your Hero Souls across the ancients you own using the community Rules of Thumb. Ported from the <link>kepow.org optimizer</link>.

builds.title: Builds
builds.body: Idle levels everything against Siyalatas, active against Fragsworth. Hybrid levels both, with the ratio setting how many Fragsworth levels you buy per Siyalatas level.

bestHero.title: Best hero
bestHero.body: Each hero tier has a different gold-to-damage ratio, which changes how far the gold ancients are worth levelling.

instakill.intro: Once every monster dies in one hit, speed comes down to monsters per zone and frames per kill. This works out both from your Kumawakamaru and Borb levels.

monstersPerZone.title: Monsters per zone
monstersPerZone.body: Zones start at 10 monsters and gain 0.1 every 500 zones. Kumawakamaru removes up to 8, Borb multiplies that, and nothing goes below 2.

routeTime.title: Route time
routeTime.body: Each kill takes 15 frames, or 14 with AC instakill. Frames are added up zone by zone and divided by your FPS.

mercenary.intro: Lays out your mercenaries in one table, alongside the lifetime stats the game tracks but rarely shows.

roster.title: Roster
roster.body: Level, experience, time to die, bonus lives, last quest and its success chance for every slot.

lifetimeStats.title: Lifetime stats
lifetimeStats.body: Mercenaries revived and buried, highest level reached, and quests completed by reward type.

relic.intro: Lists every relic in your save in one table, with the equipped ones first and the relic totals the game keeps.

relics.title: Relics
relics.body: Equipment slot, name, type, rarity, level and upgrade count for every relic you own, including the one in the junk pile.

bonuses.title: Bonuses and totals
bonuses.body: Each bonus by the ancient it levels and how many levels, plus Forge Cores, relics received and relic quests completed.

relicEditor.intro: Changes the relics in a save: their rarity, bonuses and points, where they sit, and your Forge Cores. You can also add new relics or remove old ones.

editing.title: What you can edit
editing.body: Rarity from Common to Legendary, up to four bonuses per relic with their points, equipment slots and the junk pile, and Forge Cores.

safety.title: Keeping the save loadable
safety.body: Only bonuses confirmed in game are offered, because an unknown one stops the save loading. Keep a backup of your save before importing an edited one.

outsiders.intro: Turns the Ancient Souls in your save into outsider levels and estimates where the transcension ends. Ported from <link>Driej’s outsiders calculator</link>.

spendingOrder.title: Spending order
spendingOrder.body: Borb first, then Rhageist, K’Ariqua, Orphalas and Sen-Akhan up to their caps. The rest goes to Chor’gorloth, Phandoryss and Ponyboy, whichever is worth most per soul.

applying.title: Applying the levels
applying.body: The plan uses every Ancient Soul you have earned, so respec in game first, or apply the levels to your save and import it.

removeClanData.intro: A save also holds your clan and account details. Strip them before posting a save for help or giving it to someone else.

removed.title: What gets removed
removed.body: All clan fields, including raid class, plus email, password hash, account and login fields. Your progress is untouched.

saveConverter.intro: PC and mobile saves hold the same data but are compressed differently, so a save from one will not import on the other. This re-encodes it for the other platform.

difference.title: The difference
difference.body: PC saves use raw deflate; mobile saves wrap the same JSON in zlib. Older legacy saves are recognised too.

saveJson.intro: A save is one large JSON object under the encoding. Decode it, edit any field by hand, and encode it back.

careful.title: Be careful
careful.body: Nothing checks your values against what the game expects. Keep the original and change one thing at a time.

transcension.intro: The game keeps a history of your recent transcensions and ascensions but never shows it. This reads it out of your save.

shows.title: What it shows
shows.body: Duration, ascensions, highest zone, Hero Souls and Ancient Souls for each transcension. Pick one to see its ascensions.

helps.title: Why it helps
helps.body: When the last few ascensions added little for the time they took, it is time to transcend.

saveEditor.heading: Free Clicker Heroes Save Decoder and Editor
saveEditor.intro: This browser-based Clicker Heroes save editor decodes save strings, exposes editable game data, and re-encodes the result for import back into Clicker Heroes. It is built for restoring progress, testing builds, creating specific save states, and inspecting what is inside a Clicker Heroes save file.

progress.title: Editable Progress
progress.body: Change gold, rubies, Hero Souls, ascensions, transcensions, zone data, clan values, outsiders, and custom fields.

heroes.title: Heroes and Unlocks
heroes.body: Inspect and adjust heroes, levels, gilds, skins, mercenaries, achievements, and profile-related save values.

clientSide.title: Client-Side Tool
clientSide.body: Save strings are decoded and encoded locally in the browser, so the workflow stays fast and does not require installing a desktop trainer or mod.
